author: Apazin

title: Read the warning at the end
body:
If you’d like to be reminded of & track your completion rate for a regular scheduled activity, this might be the solution for you. But after a year of ‘premium’ I am deleting the app. Here’s why:

1) ‘premium’ unlocks more ‘habits’ but as you try to track more you realise the UI is only good for a very short list. So ironically the free experience is more functional than the paid one (unless you need syncing across devices). 

2) there is no good way to track something you want to do regularly, but not to a strict schedule (eg call a friend once a fortnight)

3) there is no good way to track occurrences of a negative habit (eg how many times did I gamble this month?)

4) given all that, I would argue the subscription is overpriced at $99.99 AU, but it gets worse:

5) If you don’t pay it, the cynical developer offers a 90% discount making it reasonable. But then it’s going to renew at full price! Unsubscribe and you get the 90% offer back to try to entrap you again in next year! Seriously - BE WARNED!

title: So helpful!!
body:
Remembering simple things can be difficult for me due to my ADHD, but I’ve used the app to make a game out of the tasks! Seeing if I can beat the set times for tasks and how many habits I can tick off tricks me into doing what I need to get done! 

I also love the widget feature, that way I can’t have it “out of sight out of mind” like normal planners! 

I will suggest that a habit have a “notes section” for example what to bring to prepare for tasks.

Overall I’m very pleased with this app! Very happy that I got a special on the subscription! Definitely worth it!

title: Good but...
body:
This is a good app but it needs a way to manage reminders. It’s either turn them all off, or all on—and there are way too many reminders.

The app has built-in timers, which I use for certain habits. If I turn off reminders, I don’t get notified when the timer ends!! 

Please let users configure reminders per habit, limit the number of reminders per day, and schedule the time of day when reminders are most useful. 

Thanks

title: Great look, nice integration, but flawed
body:
The timer doesn't chime if the phone is sleeping, or often when I'm in other apps. I think that it's important for the timer to chime in the background no matter what. 

Also, please include a way to indicate how many more times per week/day I have to complete a task on the today screen. It's a big motivation to know. 

Apart from that, beautiful app with a reasonable asking price. Thank you for including a one-time option.
